newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider confirms sale of Spie.
newsitem.headline: Schneider confirms sale of Spie.

text.p: Schneider said on Thursday it had signed an agreement on Wednesday for the sale of 58.4 percent of construction company Spie Batignolles' capital to employees' firm Financiere Spie Batignolles and 41.6 percent to Amec Plc of Britain in a 350 million franc transaction.
The European Commission cleared the deal earlier this month.

Schneider, an electrical equipment company, said in a statement it would also transfer 19.23 percent of its directly-held 50 percent interest in the capital of electrical supplier Spie Trindel to Financiere Spie Trindel on Thursday. In exchange it will own 27.8 percent of Financiere Spie Trindel.
On Friday it will sell the remaining 30.77 percent to Financiere Spie Trindel for 400 million francs.

"Lastly Spie Batignolles has agreed to acquire from Schneider the remaining 27.8 percent of Financiere Spie Trindel within a maximum period of four years for an index-linked value of 250 million francs," it said in the statement. "The total transaction represents a total of one billion francs."
